articles.title: India Weather Tomorrow (October 24): IMD Predicts Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms in Several States; Check Forecast & Latest Update - The Sunday Guardian
articles.full_text:
India Weather Tomorrow (October 24): Weather conditions across India are expected to vary on Saturday, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting heavy rainfall in several southern states and island regions, while parts of northwest India may also experience showers. Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are among the regions to watch, while Delhi-NCR may see a different weather pattern. With heavy rain, thunderstorms and gusty winds possible in some areas, residents are advised to follow the latest weather updates and local advisories before travelling.
India Weather Tomorrow (October 24): Which States Are Likely to Receive Heavy Rainfall on October 24?
According to the latest reported IMD forecast, heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Kerala, Mahe and Lakshadweep on October 24. Heavy showers are also expected in parts of Andhra Pradesh, coastal Karnataka and south interior Karnataka, while the Andaman and Nicobar Islands may experience active rainfall. Residents in vulnerable areas should remain alert to waterlogging, lightning and localised disruptions.
What Is the IMD Forecast for Delhi-NCR, Punjab and Haryana?
Delhi-NCR, Punjab and Haryana may experience a change in weather conditions over the weekend, with isolated to scattered rainfall possible on October 24 and 25. Parts of Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Uttarakhand may also receive showers. However, the forecast varies by location, so residents should check district-wise updates before making travel plans.
Will Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka Experience Thunderstorms?
Southern India is expected to remain a key focus of rainfall activity, with Tamil Nadu, Kerala and parts of Karnataka facing the possibility of heavy showers, thunderstorms and lightning. Gusty winds may accompany rain in some locations, potentially affecting road travel and outdoor activities. Fishermen and coastal residents should follow official marine and weather advisories, particularly in Kerala and Lakshadweep.
Are Heatwave Conditions Expected Anywhere in India on October 24?
The available reports for October 24 primarily highlight rainfall across southern and island regions, alongside possible showers in parts of northwest India. They do not establish a specific heatwave warning for October 24. Residents should consult the latest IMD district-wise bulletin for confirmed temperature alerts rather than assuming that heatwave conditions will persist across any particular state.
What Precautions Should People Take Amid Rain and Thunderstorm Alerts?
People in areas expecting heavy rain should monitor official weather updates, avoid flooded roads and stay away from exposed locations during lightning. Coastal residents and fishermen should follow any active warnings issued by authorities. Travellers should check road and transport conditions before departure, as intense showers and gusty winds can cause localised disruption. For the most accurate information, refer to the India Meteorological Department's official website.
Disclaimer: Weather forecasts may change. It is recommended to check the latest official IMD alerts for your district before travelling or making weather-related decisions.
